title: Rajasthan private universities recorded July 2026 UG reporting and admission closing dates
description: Examine the July 2026 reporting and closing notices at Vivekananda Global University and RNB Global University alongside Rajasthan’s 10 agriculture institutions.
summary: Vivekananda Global University recorded a 24 July 2026 UG reporting date and RNB Global University stated a 30 July 2026 admission closing date for 2026–27, illustrating how Rajasthan’s private universities manage admissions alongside the state JET route.

sections.heading: Sourced July 2026 milestones at Rajasthan universities
paragraphs: Two Rajasthan universities in the research collection preserved specific July 2026 administrative dates on their public admission pages: [Vivekananda Global University](/university/vivekananda-global-university) in Jaipur published 24 July 2026 as its undergraduate reporting date, while [RNB Global University](/university/rnb-global-university) in Bikaner listed 30 July 2026 as the closing date on its 2026–27 admission procedure page.

Because university web headers often continue displaying "Admissions 2026" banners after a stated deadline passes, applicants must verify whether late or spot seats remain open before paying an application fee.

sections.heading: Comparing Rajasthan JET and university-level admission channels
paragraphs: Across Rajasthan, applicants can compare ten ICAR-listed institutions: [Jagan Nath University, Jaipur](/university/jagan-nath-university-jaipur), [Jaipur National University](/university/jaipur-national-university), [Janardan Rai Nagar Rajasthan Vidyapeeth](/university/janardan-rai-nagar-rajasthan-vidyapeeth), [Vivekananda Global University](/university/vivekananda-global-university), [Bhupal Nobles' University](/university/bhupal-nobles-university), [Suresh Gyan Vihar University](/university/suresh-gyan-vihar-university), [RNT College of Agriculture](/university/rnt-college-of-agriculture) (affiliated to MPUAT Udaipur), [Tantia University](/university/tantia-university), [Raffles University](/university/raffles-university) and [RNB Global University](/university/rnb-global-university).

Read [Rajasthan JET and agriculture college admission routes](/articles/rajasthan-jet-agriculture-admission) to see where state JET counselling applies and where private universities use direct merit or CUET/university entrance tests.

faqs.question: Does every private university in Rajasthan admit students only through Rajasthan JET?
faqs.answer: No. While MPUAT-affiliated colleges such as RNT College of Agriculture and designated state seats follow Rajasthan JET, several private universities also publish university entrance or CUET/merit routes.

faqs.question: Why do some Rajasthan universities show different fees for Rajasthan and outside-Rajasthan students?
faqs.answer: Institutions like RNB Global University publish domicile-differentiated fee pages. Always check the fee schedule matching your domicile category.
